name: Behl Designs
old_description: in custom textiles designed by Behl and made by skilled artisans
about:
Behl Designs operates from Wellesley, Massachusetts, where founder Priyanka Behl established the studio after a career in the textile industry. Raised in India amid vibrant textiles and artisan traditions, Behl began with scarf design before expanding into custom home furnishings. The business remains closely tied to its Indian roots, with Behl traveling regularly to oversee production alongside local artisans.

The studio creates custom textiles and finished products — including hand-beaded window coverings, hand-embroidered furniture, pillows, and shower curtains — using techniques such as weaving, embroidery, and printing. Behl Designs also provides workroom services and collaborates with artists and artisans to produce their designs, offering textile swatches and yardage to interior designers. Production is carried out by skilled artisans in India under Behl’s direct supervision.

Clients include interior designers seeking swatches and custom yardage, artists and artisans looking for production partners, and homeowners purchasing exclusive items from the studio’s own line. The company serves the interior design, home furnishings, and artisan collaboration sectors.

Behl Designs was born from Behl’s lifelong fascination with global cultures, colors, and craftsmanship. She cites her upbringing in India, years in Hong Kong, and extensive travels as ongoing sources of inspiration, and emphasizes hands-on collaboration with artisans to develop unique patterns and textiles.
